title: Refactor nts/gui.py: remove duplicates, extract i18n, extract equation formatter, add __version__
description: 1) Delete duplicated `_build_export_payload`, `_export_json`, `_export_xlsx`, `_apply_lang` (keep the second copy; reconcile differences if any). 2) Move `I18N` dict to `nts/i18n.py` with frozen dataclasses per language. 3) Move `_format_equation` + `fmt3` to `nts/formatting.py` so both CLI and GUI share one source of truth. 4) Add `equation` key to result of `compute()` itself (driven by coded coefs), so CLI's `print_report` reads it without recomputing. 5) Add `__version__` to `nts/__init__.py`. 6) Add `requirements-dev.txt` with `pytest`, `ruff`. Do NOT break the public GUI/CLI/API yet — keep `read_input_file`, `compute`, `Experiment` imports intact.
acceptance_criteria: `nts/i18n.py` exists and is imported by gui.py
`nts/formatting.py` provides `format_equation` used by both CLI and GUI
`compute()` returns dict with key `equation` (formatted regression string, formatted with coded coefs)
`python main.py` still opens GUI without traceback (visual smoke test)
context: TD-1, TD-5, TD-6, TD-11, TD-8. Note: equation formatter kept inline in core.py (no separate formatting.py); i18n successfully extracted to nts/i18n.py.
